newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK external trade value by sea up 2.3 pct in H1 96.
newsitem.headline: HK external trade value by sea up 2.3 pct in H1 96.

text.p: The value of Hong Kong's external trade by ocean totaled HK$674.6 billion in the first half of 1996, up 2.3 percent over the same period in 1995 and accounting for 49 percent of total external trade, the Census and Statistics department said on Wednesday.
Value of trade by land rose 3.4 percent to HK$349.3 billion, accounting for 25 percent. Air transport trade rose 5.4 percent to HK$280.4 billion, accounting for 20 percent.
